target.consumer: universal worker allocator / stale recovery / stress verifier

canonical_identity.problem: stale recovery can admit unsafe retry/overlap evidence and lacks a deterministic one-winner execution fence for the same stale generation, allowing duplicate recovery claims/runs
acceptance: one stale generation has exactly one execution winner; losing recovery attempts persist evidence and cannot seed a second run
retryable=false cannot be bypassed by read-only recovery
overlap evidence is tri-state and UNKNOWN cannot be serialized or asserted as NO_ACTIVE_OVERLAP
generated and persisted recovery-claim schemas are canonicalized or explicitly adapted
a recovery claim alone does not refresh worker liveness without STARTED or heartbeat evidence
a two-worker recovery race and late-original-return case are independently stress-verified with immutable history preserved
